pages.text: Right-click casts your weapon's first spell. While you hold a spell weapon, the hotbar keys cast the spells shown on the spell bar above it. Hold $(k:keybindings.spell_engine.bypass_spell_hotbar) to use your normal hotbar instead.

Many spells burn $(item)runes$(). Make them at a $(item)Rune Crafting Altar$(): it gives more runes for the same materials than a crafting table.$(br2)Defeating Ignis earns a book of $(item)Spell Infinity$(): on your weapon, spells stop using runes.
